purpose: Teach: はずす/淋しい/逢い/ぐったり/たいがい/楽々/あわせる/あたえ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、メガネをはずすと顔が違って見えるわね
lines.en: Your face looks different without your glasses, Sho.
lines.style: Light, affectionate observation. Warm amusement in the eyes—noticing something small about him. Not teasing, just seeing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんがいなくて淋しいよ
lines.style: Quiet, reaching—the particular vulnerability of a six-year-old naming something that hurts. Open and honest without performance. Slight pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんとお家で逢いましょうね
lines.en: We'll visit Grandpa at home soon, okay?
lines.style: Gentle reassurance. Soft on the opening—a promise meant to land. Steady, the way a mother's voice can settle something in a child. Not rushing past his feeling.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、運動会の後、ぐったりしちゃった
lines.en: After the sports day, you were completely worn out.
lines.style: Mild observation with affection underneath. The tone of someone who noticed him dragging, remembering how hard he pushed. Understated acknowledgment of his effort.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、たいがいのことはお父さんに相談しなさい
lines.en: For most things, talk to your dad about it, alright?
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact guidance. Not unkind—just clear. The voice of someone redirecting, trusting the other parent. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノが楽々弾けるようになったよ
lines.en: You can play the piano so smoothly now.
lines.style: Genuine pride and pleasure. Warm recognition of his progress. The words land with quiet certainty—she means it. A mother noticing real growth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに時間をあわせるのは大事よ
lines.en: It's important to make time to match your dad's schedule, you know.
lines.style: Practical wisdom delivered gently. Not lecturing—guiding. The tone of someone teaching without pushing. Clear but warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが好物をあたえて下さったよ
lines.en: Grandpa gave you some of your favorite food!
lines.style: Bright warmth, sharing in his delight. Quick tempo, genuinely pleased at his happiness. The lift of a mother delighted by what her son has received. Open, eager with him.
